gaps.explanation: Re-read p6 (GAAP governmental funds statement, printed p21), budget-basis schedules p7-8 General (printed pp67-68), p9 Road (p69), p10 Health Center (p70) and the nonmajor combining statements pp11-13 (printed pp83-85). Statement total revenues 412,425,510 = General 282,098,103 + Road 30,078,561 + Health Center 52,514,292 + Nonmajor 47,734,554. Detail 445,206,626 = General budget basis 317,530,367 + Road 29,255,351 (lines; printed total 29,255,350) + Health Center 50,686,354 + nonmajor fund columns 47,734,554 (= p6 Nonmajor column exactly; each nonmajor fund appears once, from pp11-13 only). No fund is in detail from two sources, no subtotal/total or budget column is recorded as a line, and no transfer or balance is recorded as revenue. Per fund, statement - detail on the same printed rows: General -35,432,264 = Property and real estate 119,721,543 vs 116,554,717 (+3,166,826) + Homestead 3,067,609 vs 3,067,610 (-1) + Motor vehicle 21,352,524 vs 22,390,351 (-1,037,827) + Payments in lieu 2,364,732 vs 2,364,733 (-1) + Miscellaneous taxes 2,596,185 vs 15,324,737 (-12,728,552) + Charges for services 68,680,497 vs 58,892,394 (+9,788,103) + Intergovernmental 47,899,488 vs 82,543,987 (-34,644,499) + investment earnings 1,397,276 - 4,578,360 = -3,181,084 vs -3,204,771 (+23,687); Carline 230,647 and Inheritance 19,365,962 equal. Road +823,210 = Charges 8,020,190 vs 7,667,797 (+352,393) + Intergovernmental 21,812,446 vs 21,341,629 (+470,817) (GAAP 'Motor vehicle' 245,925 = budget 'Property tax' 245,925). Health Center +1,827,938 = Property 14,478,018 vs 14,981,797 (-503,779) + in lieu 137,362 vs 114,527 (+22,835) + Charges 35,854,733 vs 35,171,884 (+682,849) + Intergovernmental 1,626,033 vs '-' (the p10 schedule prints the Intergovernmental row with nil actual; not added: on the budget basis this money may sit in the General Fund's budget-basis Intergovernmental 82,543,987, which is 34.6M above GAAP, so adding it could count it twice). Sum -35,432,264 + 823,210 + 1,827,938 = -32,781,116 = gap. The budget-to-GAAP reconciliation (notes to required supplementary information after printed p70) is not in the trim. Budget basis vs GAAP printed on both sides; nothing to add or remove.

Statement total expenditures 399,711,267 (p6) = General 265,611,648 + Road 27,968,988 + Health Center 55,748,409 + Nonmajor 50,382,222. Detail 443,183,025.14 = General budget-basis department lines 306,284,209.14 (p7-8; several actuals printed with cents; printed Total expenditures 306,284,210) + Road Transportation services 30,936,605 (p9) + Health Center Public health/social services 55,579,989 (p10) + nonmajor 50,382,222 (special revenue 42,975,265 p12 + debt service 7,406,957 p13 = p6 Nonmajor column). Each department line is printed once and recorded once; no subtotal, budget column or prior-year amount is in detail. Per fund (detail - statement): General +40,672,561.14 (budget-basis departments incl. Employee Fringe 40,261,746.67, Employee Medical 38,498,394.79, Administration 18,929,135 vs GAAP functions General government 117,135,713, Public safety 89,987,474, Public safety judicial 31,898,710, Ecological 18,980,087, Transportation 232,083, bond interest 193,097, lease principal 1,244,376, lease interest 480,742, capital outlay 5,459,366; the budget schedule prints Capital Outlay '-' and no debt service rows because those payments are charged inside the departments, so the GAAP rows are not added); Road +2,967,617 (30,936,605 vs Transportation 10,274,851 + lease principal 4,810 + lease interest 746 + capital outlay 17,688,581); Health Center -168,420 (55,579,989 vs public health 54,183,690 + bond principal 650,000 + bond interest 56,183 + lease principal 102,322 + lease interest 6,631 + capital outlay 749,583). 40,672,561.14 + 2,967,617 - 168,420 = 43,471,758.14 = -gap. Budget basis vs GAAP; reconciliation page not in the trim. Nothing to add or remove.

Statement p6 Transfers in 18,924,567 = General 6,151,408 + Health Center 4,000,000 + Nonmajor 8,773,159. Detail 16,317,103 = General budget basis 1,733,580 (p8) + Health Center 4,000,000 (p10) + nonmajor gross per fund 10,583,523 (Community Service 500,000, Health Department 4,499,999, State Institutions 500,000, Veterans 500,000 p11; Escrow Liability 273,160 p12; Debt Service 1,000,000, Public Safety Bond 3,310,364 p13; p13 Total Nonmajor Governmental 10,583,523). Gap 2,607,464 = General 6,151,408 - 1,733,580 = 4,417,828 (same row, GAAP vs budget basis; adding the GAAP figure would count the 1,733,580 twice) - 1,810,364 (Correction Bond -> Public Safety Bond transfer printed gross on p13, netted in the p6 Nonmajor column: 10,583,523 - 8,773,159). Nothing to add or remove.

Gap -1,537,205 = General 12,773,159 - 12,500,000 = +273,159 (same row, GAAP vs budget basis) - 1,810,364 (intra-nonmajor transfer printed gross on p13, netted on p6: 6,068,239 - 4,257,875). No duplicate: each transfer is printed once in its fund column and recorded once. Nothing to add or remove.
